senses.gloss: m. (supposed to be a Persian word, expl. by R. Ḥănanel by Arabic banîke) gusset, gore.
units: <cite ref="Shabbat 98b">Sabb. 98ᵇ</cite> <he>שפי</he> … <he>עד דט׳</he> Ar. (read <he>כי ט׳</he>, v. Koh. Ar. Compl. s. v., ed. <he>כי טורין</he>) they planed the boards (so as to be gradually decreasing in thickness) like a gusset; Yalk. Ex. 370 <he>כי טורין</he>.
